hits.title: BYD unveils Xiao Di, its first humanoid robot - Venture Atlas
hits.snippet: Home News Friday, August 7, 2026 # BYD unveils Xiao Di, its first humanoid robot BYD BYD publicly unveiled its first humanoid robot, named Xiao Di, at the Di Space brand-experience center in Zhengzhou in early August 2026, joining Tesla, Unitree, XPeng and Chery in the humanoid-robot race.
